g.text: Neither process spends its time where you would guess
xperf, -stackwalk Profile only, so these are CPU samples and not context switches. Reading the source is 53% of rsync's CPU inclusive; the cipher is only a fifth of ssh's.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W) · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U (16 threads) · Thunderbolt networking, MTU 65330, link 20 Gbit/s
